Olive Citrus Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 12:14am

Ingredients




1 inch lrg Head Romaine lettuce (you may mix other kind
1/2 cup Slivered almonds or walnuts, toasted
1/2 medium Red onion, sliced, separated into rings
1 can Mandarin oranges
1 cup Chopped ripe olives
3 tablespoons Honey
3 tablespoons White wine vinegar
2 tablespoons Vegetable oil
1/2 teaspoon Dried rosemary leaves
1/4 teaspoon Dried basil leaves
1/4 teaspoon Pepper

Preparation

1 Combine dressing ingredients, mix well, cover and refrigerate overnight. 2 Mix salad ingredients and serve with dressing. 3 TIME INCLUDED REFRIGERATING 4 OVERNIGHT
